# Eternal Toolbox

> Eternal Toolbox is a Blender addon by EternalShade3D that reports evaluated (truth) dimensions through the whole modifier stack and scales Object or Edit Mode selections to an exact typed size.

Eternal Toolbox ships as an extension-format `.zip`. Blender's native `object.dimensions` reports the raw mesh cage and ignores modifiers; Eternal Toolbox reads the evaluated Dependency Graph output instead, so the number on screen is the number you would measure in the finished scene.

## Quick facts

- Product: Eternal Toolbox, a Blender addon, extension manifest ready
- Maker: EternalShade3D
- Blender versions: 4.2 LTS and later
- Modes: Object Mode and Edit Mode
- Pivot support: Median Point, 3D Cursor, Active Element
- Units: scene length units, metric and imperial
- Platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux
- Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later

## Modules

- Truth Dimensions: evaluated Depsgraph bounding dimensions, live, including Subdivision Surface, Bevel, Solidify and Geometry Nodes
- Edit Mode scaling: read the exact size of selected faces, edges or vertices, then scale to a typed value while respecting the active Transform Pivot Point
- Smart Origin Alignment: nine point compass grid, geometry median, 3D cursor snapping
- Naming Engine: preset based asset naming with date prefixing and batch rename
- Scene Hygiene: duplicate material cleanup (`.001`) and orphan data purging
- Color Utilities: random visual debugging colours for loose parts and UV islands
- Camera Screenshots: batch capture every scene camera, auto cropped frame
- Perimeter and Edge Readout: closed loop perimeter length and open segment edge measurements

## Installation

1. Get the `.zip` from one of the [official stores](https://eternalshade3d.github.io/EternalShade3D-Toolbox/#pricing)
2. In Blender open Edit > Preferences > Add-ons
3. Choose Install from Disk and select the `.zip`
4. Enable the addon checkbox
5. Press N in the 3D Viewport and open the sidebar tab

Full steps with screenshots are in the [documentation](https://eternalshade3d.github.io/EternalShade3D-Toolbox/#docs).

## FAQ

- Which Blender versions are supported? 4.2 LTS and later, through the extension manifest standard.
- Does it work with modifiers? Yes. Dimensions come from the evaluated geometry, not the raw mesh cage.
- Does it work in Edit Mode? Yes. Selections report exact dimensions and can be scaled to a typed value.
- How many machines can I install it on? Personal workstations belonging to the licence holder.
- Are updates included? Yes, lifetime updates.
